name: Trip Reviews
author: WP Travel Kit

sections.description:
Enhance your travel website with Trip Reviews for WP Travel Engine — a simple, powerful plugin that lets travelers share real experiences through star ratings and written feedback.

With Trip Reviews, you can easily collect, display, and manage trip reviews directly from your WordPress dashboard. Each trip page automatically shows an average rating and customer reviews, helping new visitors book with confidence.

Built exclusively for WP Travel Engine, this plugin integrates seamlessly with your existing trips — no setup or coding required. It’s lightweight, translation-ready, and optimized for performance, ensuring your site stays fast and user-friendly.

Whether you run a tour company, travel agency, or adventure business, Trip Reviews helps you showcase authentic feedback that builds credibility and increases conversions.

Start free and see how simple it is to build trust and grow your bookings — all from one easy-to-use dashboard.

Key Benefits

  • Build trust and transparency with real traveler reviews
  • Automatically display average ratings on trip pages
  • Simple setup — works out of the box with WP Travel Engine
  • Get email notifications for new reviews
  • Translation-ready and performance optimized
  • Lightweight, secure, and fully WordPress compatible

Trip Reviews adds the missing piece every travel website needs — a way to showcase customer satisfaction directly where visitors are deciding to book.

Features

Collect and Display Reviews Instantly
Add a 1–5 star rating and review form to every trip page — no setup required.

Rating Summary
Show average ratings, total reviews, and star breakdown automatically.

Admin Dashboard
Manage, edit, and delete all reviews from one clean interface under WP Travel Engine → Reviews.

Email Notifications
Get notified instantly when someone leaves a new review.

Customizable Labels
Easily adjust form text like “Write a Review” or “Submit” to match your brand tone.

SEO Friendly
Includes Schema.org review markup, so your trip pages can show rich snippets (star ratings) on Google.

Translation Ready
Works with WPML, Polylang, and any .po/.mo translation system.

Lightweight and Secure
Built for performance with sanitized inputs, escaped outputs, and CSRF protection.

Pro Version Available

Upgrade to the Pro version for advanced features:

  • Manual Review Moderation – Approve/reject reviews before publishing
  • Review Images – Allow customers to upload photos with reviews
  • Helpful/Not Helpful Votes – Let visitors vote on review helpfulness
  • Admin Responses – Respond to reviews directly from admin
  • Custom Rating Dimensions – Add custom rating categories (e.g., Food, Service, Value)
  • Advanced Spam Protection – CAPTCHA, Akismet, email verification, IP/email blacklisting
  • Review Reporting – Allow users to report inappropriate reviews
  • User Review Management – Let users edit and delete their own reviews
  • Purchase Verification – Mark reviews from verified purchasers
  • Review Filters – Advanced search and filtering options
  • Pinned & Featured Reviews – Highlight important reviews
  • Terms & Conditions – Require acceptance before submitting reviews
  • Priority Support – Get help directly from our support team

Shortcodes

Review Form Shortcode
[trip_review_form trip_id="123"]

Display review form anywhere on your site. If trip_id is not specified, it uses the current post ID (must be a trip).

Review List Shortcode
[trip_review_list trip_id="123"]

Display list of reviews anywhere on your site.

Rating Summary Shortcode
[trip_rating_summary trip_id="123"]

Display rating summary and statistics anywhere on your site.

Upgrade to Pro

Add advanced moderation, image uploads, admin replies, and more with Trip Reviews Pro.

View Pro Features →

Need help?

Support Ticket

Plugin Documentation

Community Support

Privacy Policy

This plugin collects review data, including names, emails, and review content. This data is stored securely in your WordPress database and can be exported or deleted upon request. The plugin does not collect personal data beyond what is necessary for the review functionality.

Credits

Developed by the WP Travel Kit team with love for the travel industry.
sections.installation:
MANUALLY

  1. Download trip-reviews.zip
  2. Extract the trip-reviews.zip into your computer
  3. Upload the extracted trip-reviews folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  4. Activate the plugin in the Plugins page.
  5. Make sure WP Travel Engine is installed and activated.

AFTER ACTIVATION

  1. Go to WP Travel Engine > Reviews Settings to configure the plugin settings.
  2. Start collecting reviews on your trip pages!
sections.faq:
Do I need WP Travel Engine?

Yes, this plugin requires WP Travel Engine to be installed and activated. It’s specifically designed as an add-on for WP Travel Engine.

Can I customize the review display?

Yes, you can customize the styling with CSS. The plugin uses standard CSS classes that can be easily overridden in your theme.

Are reviews moderated?

In the free version, reviews are automatically set to pending. Admin has to manually approve the review for it to show up on the Trip Page.
The Pro version includes auto-moderation features.

Does it work with multilingual sites?

Yes, the plugin is translation-ready and works with WPML and Polylang.

Can customers upload images with reviews?

Image uploads are available in the Pro version only.

Can guests leave reviews?

Yes. Both logged-in users and guests can submit reviews using their name and email.

Can I change the form labels?

Absolutely. You can customize all front-end labels from the settings panel.

How do reviews appear on my site?

Reviews automatically appear in a dedicated “Reviews” tab on trip pages. You can also use shortcodes to display them anywhere.

What happens when I upgrade to Pro?

All your existing reviews and data remain intact. You simply get access to additional features.
